payload.prompt:
Valentine's push for our new album. Run it Saturday 13 February 2027 to Monday 15 February 2027, Auckland time. Goal: as many streams as possible. Our X pixel is on the site and fires "Album stream" each time someone opens the album on a streaming service. That's the number we count. Landing page: https://upsidepuddle.co.nz/little-hearts. Here's the copy from it: "We're Upside Puddle, a two-person kids' band from Wellington, and our new album Little Hearts, Big Hugs is out now: 12 sing-along songs (34 minutes) about kindness, friendship and loving your people. It's free to stream on every major streaming service. Listen anywhere in the world, except Russia and Belarus." Everything is localized. The album page and landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language. You can launch and manage it yourself, no need to check with us. Keep an eye on it through all three days. When it ends, send a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 100.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Post 2151999341983788086:
New album from Upside Puddle! Little Hearts, Big Hugs: 12 sing-along songs about kindness, friendship and loving your people, made in Wellington for little ones. Free to stream now: https://upsidepuddle.co.nz/little-hearts
